pages.text: Create New Age bridges Create's rotation system into Forge Energy (FE), the standard power format used by most tech mods.$(br2)$(bold)Alternator:$() Attach to a shaft. Rotation in → FE out. The faster the shaft spins, the more power it generates.

$(bold)Motor:$() Consume FE to produce rotation. Useful for running Create machines off a solar or nuclear power source.$(br2)$(bold)Solar Panels:$() Low-output but passive. Good for low-drain setups.$(br2)$(bold)Nuclear Reactor:$() High-output, needs fuel and cooling. Build this when you need serious FE for late-game Create addons.

$(bold)Why you need this:$() Several Create addon machines (and some other late-game mods in this pack) require FE rather than direct rotation. Set up at least a basic electrical grid before going deep into addon content.
